result.claim: Only this bounded selection; no native aggregate or release qualification.

scope: A separate owned diagnostic executes two reverse-order blocks of 120 trusted keys per textarea, bare CodeMirror and admitted card on desktop and CPU-4x Android emulation. Both projects use 1280x900 and the unchanged UI-seeded, fully cold-verified 300-card/400-line corpus. All 1,440 raw timing samples, 12 p95 rows and four source-mapped CPU profiles are retained; profiled typing is separate from timing and all added writing survives lock/reopen. Desktop card p95 is 17.2/18.3 ms; Android is 92.9/93.7 ms. Controls vary: desktop textarea 1.6/1.4, bare CodeMirror 1.9/15.5; Android textarea 7/6, bare CodeMirror 8.6/19 ms. Sampling over 60 additional card keys attributes 647.2/3106.6 ms inclusive to private preparation and 237.1/1105.2 ms to projection verification (desktop/Android); nested inclusive values must not be added. These are sampled aggregates, not per-key quantiles or causal speedup estimates. The first attempt was cancelled after read-only inspection found the app service worker replacing the control page with the unlock UI; its receipt, drain evidence and exact patch are retained. Controls now use a separate disposable context with service workers blocked and explicit title/input assertions; the application context is unchanged. Control assets use their own URL prefix. The pilot has no relaxed timing assertions: its success means complete diagnostic evidence only. Original application fixtures, 30-metric census and all nine budgets remain unchanged and the preceding performance gate remains failed. No production source, custody, admission, transport or personal app artifact changes. The standalone latency command excludes this owned-only diagnostic; its explicit runner selection includes exactly four cases. Sampling and limitations were specified before the pilot in docs/latency-diagnosis.md. The two native browser-runner controls also pass, including omission, skip, hook failure, deadline, cancellation and process drain.
